key_insight: Independent reproduction and external testing show that RXNGraphormer is both reproducible and transferable for reaction prediction. However, its performance drops in heterogeneous or distribution-shifted datasets, highlighting limits to generalization.
problem_solved: This paper addresses whether RXNGraphormer can be reliably reproduced by independent researchers and whether it remains effective on external datasets beyond its original evaluation setting.
method: Independently reproduced the RXNGraphormer results to verify experimental consistency.
Evaluated the model on external benchmark datasets for reaction prediction tasks.
Compared performance under standard conditions versus heterogeneous and distribution-shifted settings to assess robustness.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this study provides evidence that RXNGraphormer can be trusted as a reproducible baseline and useful transfer model. It also warns that strong in-domain results do not guarantee robustness across different data distributions.

paper_title: Reusability report: Assessment of reproducibility and applicability to external datasets for RXNGraphormer
paper_authors: Chonghuan Zhang, Majian Zeng, Qianghua Lin, Kuangbiao Liao
